relations.operation: The performed I Am returns to identification through difference, the copula’s proper office.
The recursive failure of final definition opens formal-limit articulation.
The fourth turn makes the determining circumstance visible through its determinations.
Appearing and reflexive recognition provide the source-distinct phenomenological relation.
Personed articulation and address develop the I/you/it relation.
Definition’s cut remains dependent on what it excludes.
Singular and polyvalent halves give concrete meaning to source/manifest relation.
The whole native determination sequence places this local performed sixfold.
Image claiming source-office develops the idol failure first exposed by definition.
Fidelity opens into trust under a limit that knowledge cannot abolish.
A derivative criterion occupying source-office develops definition’s political consequence.
Covenant distinguishes source authority from the office that represents it.
Inspectable interiority does not locate phenomenal Subject by accumulation.
A representation of Other does not contain the Other; relation retains difference.
Subject-first recognition opens an argued order of dependence.
The exact sign returns as Symbol under the original non-possession condition.
Subject is definedly indefinable; present subjecthood is not another represented thing.
Definition remains faithful by making its determining act visible.
Each asserted contour is a determination with a constitutive cut.
The account does not contain the condition of its accounting.
Renewed representation reproduces the non-coincidence of act and represented condition.
Identification can retain difference without becoming inert sameness.
The three asserted positions become visible within their shared circumstance.
Form can disclose its conditioning context.
The means of knowing participates in the act and is not the Subject.
The living symbol returns to source; the idol installs its image in source-office.
Fidelity continues as trust without exhaustive possession.
Account answers source without substituting for source; register3 operational relation.
Question precedes mechanism; functional agency does not settle Subject
